regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your favor of Aug. 25 just noted. I hope things smooth off amicably between the two families. If you have opportunity, try and stress " ... Blessed are the Peace-makers for they shall be called the child- ren of God" .. Who is a more practical peace-maker than he who overlooks short-comings of a neighbor. - Please God the Enroll- ments will the Poor Souls will help. Thank God they hardly ever fail. I had quite a talk with Rae Garland and a number of others from Detroit this p.m. - long distance. All seem well and hope- ful. Thanks be to God. We had a fine retreat up near Garrison on the Hudson last week in the Monastery of the Immaculate Conception.
